name: perl-socket6
description: This Perl module provides IPv6 networking support and protocol-independent address resolution. Use when user asks to handle IPv6 socket structures, perform protocol-independent name resolution with getaddrinfo, or convert between human-readable and binary IPv6 addresses.
overview: This skill provides guidance on using the `Socket6` Perl module to bridge the gap between traditional IPv4 networking and IPv6. It is essential for scripts that need to handle `sockaddr_in6` structures, perform lookups that return both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, or use constants not available in older versions of the core `Socket` module.
